description: An eight-input precision adder with a three-way polarity switch on each input

params.text: Adds that input into the sum, subtracts it, or leaves it out altogether

inputs.text: One of the eight signals added into the sum, as the switch beside it sets; an unpatched jack adds nothing

outputs.text: The sum of the patched inputs, each one added, subtracted or left out as its switch is set

notes: the module adds polyphonically, and the output carries as many channels as the widest input
